_comment: Demo content for npm run seed. Every person, trip and comment is made up; photos are credited in photos/CREDITS.md. post fields in comments and likes are indexes into posts.

users.name: Demo Traveler
users.bio: The shared demo account. Look around!

users.name: Maya Chen
users.bio: Slow travel, street food and night trains.

users.name: Arjun Rao
users.bio: Mountains first, cities when it rains.

posts.author: maya
posts.title: Windmills above Oia
posts.content: We climbed past the blue domes at six and still had to fight for a spot by the windmills. Worth it: the caldera goes pink for about ten minutes and then the whole village claps.

posts.author: lena
posts.title: Lantern town by the river
posts.content: Boats drift past the yellow shopfronts all morning. I had cao lau three days in a row and a tailor made me a jacket in 24 hours.

posts.author: lena
posts.title: Cypress roads of Val d'Orcia
posts.content: Rented a tiny Fiat and stopped every five minutes because every bend looks like a painting. Pecorino tasting in Pienza is non-negotiable.

posts.author: diego
posts.title: A long walk to Chambord
posts.content: Cycled the Loire path from Blois. The approach down the long avenue is how the king wanted you to see it, and it still works.

posts.author: arjun
posts.title: Punting past King's College
posts.content: Our punt guide fell in the river, which was the highlight. The chapel from the water is unreal.

posts.author: maya
posts.title: Night walk across the Brooklyn Bridge
posts.content: Started in DUMBO, walked to Manhattan just after dark. Bring gloves in December; the wind on the span is no joke.

posts.author: arjun
posts.title: Sunset over Erg Chebbi
posts.content: Camel ride out, sandboarding, then the quietest night of my life under more stars than I knew existed.

posts.author: lena
posts.title: Balloon over the palms
posts.content: A 5am pickup and a balloon over the West Bank. The Valley of the Kings looks tiny from up there.

posts.author: diego
posts.title: Hairy coos of the Highlands
posts.content: Stopped the car for a cow. Stayed for an hour. Glencoe in the rain is moody in the best way.

posts.author: arjun
posts.title: Trekking toward Everest Base Camp
posts.content: Twelve days up, four down. Garlic soup every night for the altitude, and the view from Kala Patthar at sunrise made every step worth it.

posts.author: maya
posts.title: An overwater morning
posts.content: Snorkelled straight off the jetty and saw a reef shark before breakfast. The water really is that colour.

posts.author: diego
posts.title: Waterfalls after the rain
posts.content: It rained all night, so every cliff had a waterfall by morning. The boat goes right under Stirling Falls; you will get soaked.

posts.author: lena
posts.title: Quiet shores of Lake Bled
posts.content: Rowed out to the island church and rang the bell for luck. Cream cake on the terrace afterwards, as tradition demands.

posts.author: arjun
posts.title: Into the mist
posts.content: The sandstone pillars appear and vanish in the fog. The glass bridge is scarier than it looks in photos.

posts.author: maya
posts.title: Coastal line to Kamakura
posts.content: The Enoden train runs right along the sea. Got off at random stops, found a tiny ramen shop and the Great Buddha.

posts.author: diego
posts.title: Fairy lights on a Lisbon side street
posts.content: Every alley in Alfama has lights strung across it in December. Pastel de nata count for the trip: eleven.

posts.author: lena
posts.title: Fog on the Olympic coast
posts.content: Moss on everything, fog rolling off the Pacific, and not another person on the trail for hours.

posts.author: maya
posts.title: Cafe corner in Hanoi
posts.content: Egg coffee in a plant-filled cafe up three flights of stairs. Hanoi rewards anyone who looks behind a doorway.

posts.author: demo
posts.title: Clouds over Sugarloaf
posts.content: Took the cable car up just as the clouds broke. Copacabana on one side, the bay on the other.

comments.author: arjun
comments.text: That light! Adding Oia to the list.

comments.author: maya
comments.text: Respect. How bad was the altitude?

comments.author: arjun
comments.text: Fine below 4,500 m, then every step counted.

comments.author: lena
comments.text: Milford Sound is on my list for next year.

comments.author: demo
comments.text: Walked it last winter too, freezing but magic.

comments.author: diego
comments.text: Did you get the jacket in time?

comments.author: lena
comments.text: Picked it up the morning I left!
